authorization: User-authorized phase-sized execution packet through sealed behavioral result, conditional only on frozen gates passing
scientific_question: Where between optimizer steps 81 and 120 do behavioral coordinates change on a fresh trajectory, and how do those trajectories differ across DUP, MATCHED, and SHAM?
claim_boundary: Fresh model-visible inputs within the same four held-out families and p0-p3 templates; not novel-family or novel-template generalization.

prior_panel_identity_manifest.scope: five-field prior held-out panel exclusion; reconstructed from bound generator, no panel body

panel_admission.candidate_ordinal_stream: ascending ordinal 0 through 699 independently within each family; no reseed, stream splice, or ordinal reuse
panel_admission.scientific_panel_semantics: original sealed P panel contract unchanged except fresh R2 namespace/seed and online admission; same exact-world target, schema, edit, and feature definitions
panel_admission.admission_predicate: Before any candidate becomes a panel member, compute its 11 occurrence identity rows and reject the entire neighborhood if any of the five identity dimensions intersects the sealed selected-training set, prior-panel set, or any already-admitted R2 occurrence set. Independently reject if SHA256(canonical(neighborhood_id)) is in the v05 E1 denylist.
panel_admission.online_rejection: Continue only to the next ordinal in the already-frozen family stream; rejected candidates are not panel members and cannot be manually replaced or reordered.
panel_admission.internal_set_semantics: Within a candidate neighborhood, repeated world_id/root_id values across its 11 roles are expected; collision checks compare each candidate's field-value sets to the external and already-admitted sets. Add those values only after whole-neighborhood admission.
panel_admission.admission_log: One row for each consumed ordinal: ordinal, family, accepted/rejected, collision field/scope, and SHA256 of each colliding identity value; no raw excluded identity is emitted.
panel_admission.matching: Unchanged radius-only argmin absolute difference ||h_N-h_A||2 versus ||h_S-h_A||2 over neutral_1..neutral_8; frozen hash tie-break; no direction/cosine/outcome use.

post_admission_validation.internal_r2_overlap: zero between admitted neighborhoods in every field
post_admission_validation.online_admission_vs_final_audit: exact agreement required; any disagreement is an instrumentation failure
post_admission_validation.failure: seal non-promotable; no regeneration or replacement

frozen_lfm.state_feature: final-layer mean_full@16; exact length; single row; no padding; max 1024; BF16 backbone; FP32 2048-vector
frozen_lfm.candidate_feature: name — description; exact length; single row; no padding; batch size 1; mean_full@16; BF16 backbone; FP32 2048-vector

training.head: CompatibilityHead(2048, mlp, 128); 590081 trainable parameters
training.precision: float32 head/features; no autocast; no TF32 matmul
training.training_data: unchanged sealed P common primary occurrence stream and three original head-input manifests; same init per seed; new R2 fresh panel only for frozen training-source feature mapping as required

evaluation.firewall: No fresh R2 panel evaluation until all nine runs, 378 checkpoints, three init templates, training telemetry, and complete checkpoint hash tree are sealed.
evaluation.analysis: original sealed P analysis contract and trajectory metric semantics unchanged
